item.title: Coldcard firmware flaw from 2021 enables $89M in Bitcoin losses across 4,500 addresses in four successive attack waves.
SEC suspends Nasdaq bitcoin options approval as CME challenges whether CFTC holds exclusive jurisdiction over commodity-linked contracts.
US and UK recommend aligning stablecoin and tokenized-asset regulations ahead of their respective 2027 framework effective dates.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Franklin Templeton publicly back the US Clarity Act crypto market structure bill.
SEC and CFTC open joint consultation on aligning portfolio margin rules across securities and derivatives markets.
EU regulators open MiCA 2.0 consultation to revise the bloc's crypto framework, with public input accepted through September.
BNY Mellon launches institutional USDC custody and minting services, allowing clients to manage stablecoins alongside traditional assets.
JPMorgan plans to offer spot crypto trading for clients while using third-party custodians rather than holding digital assets itself.
Deutsche Bank prepares to launch institutional crypto custody accounts integrating digital assets with standard securities safekeeping.
Citigroup is on track to launch institutional bitcoin custody in 2026, offering a single account combining bitcoin, securities and cash.
SEC orders Bloom Protocol to register its BLT token as a security within 30 days or pay a $31M civil penalty.
Binance's UK subsidiary voluntarily withdraws its FCA cryptoasset registration, extending a pattern of large exchange European exits.
Ostium perpetuals protocol loses $18M to an oracle price manipulation attack, the latest in an ongoing wave targeting DeFi infrastructure.
SEC opens comment period on overhauling US ETF listing rules, potentially lowering the bar for novel and crypto-linked fund approvals.
